parameters: They cannot make it past this point!\! Hold with everything you've got!!
\n[8], this battle is over.\! Staying is suicide.
Come on... we have to evacuate everyone now!
...\| Do it, then.\! Take everyone you can get and get the hell out this place.\! Go anywhere but here.\! Diana...
Take the Historium Magnus, get out of here and fight on.\! I don't care how, just make sure these scumbags pay for everything they've done.
\n[8], you are not alone in this battle...\| Don't throw your life away!!
I'm the reason for everything.\! This entire war.\! I'm not leaving this point.\! I beg you, live on, and destroy Casamir, destroy the cultists...\! Go, get out of here!!
Zelos...\| Look at me now.\! Doing exactly what you'd do, ha ha ha!\! You want me, Casamir?!\! Come and get it.
